items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: I met Swetman. Wilbur Swetman, and Swetman was looking for a piano player... so I said, 'Yeah, I'll go'

ctx.x: When did you come into New York? Let's get into that.

I met Swetman. Wilbur Swetman, and Swetman was looking for a piano player, and I was out of a job -- well, I wasn't out of a job, but you know, it was coming on summer, and I just set three guys up there at Lake George, a summer place, so I said, "Yeah, I'll go" -- so then he ...
